description: This header file declares the interface for tasklet management within the lighttpd server, including functions for creating, managing, and executing lightweight tasklet pools and tasklets.

methods.name: li_tasklet_pool_new
methods.description: Creates a new tasklet pool associated with an event loop, with specified threading behavior.

methods.name: li_tasklet_pool_free
methods.description: Blocks until all tasks in the pool are finished and then frees the pool.

methods.name: li_tasklet_pool_set_threads
methods.description: Sets the number of threads for the tasklet pool, possibly stopping the old pool and waiting for tasks to complete.

methods.name: li_tasklet_pool_get_threads
methods.description: Returns the number of threads currently used in the tasklet pool.

methods.name: li_tasklet_push
methods.description: Pushes a new tasklet into the pool to execute a run callback, with a finished callback called upon completion.
